{{Quote|A Hutt without a sail barge is like a smoke moth without wings.|Translated from [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]|<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Khetanna''''' (commonly referred to as simply '''Jabba's sail barge''') was a [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|Luxury sail barge]], owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He used it to travel over the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and for pleasurable expeditions to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. It was generally accompanied by two skiffs, which carried the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] guards.

==Characteristics==
[[File:SailBargeCutaway-SWFB.jpg|thumb|left|250px|''Khetanna'' schematics]]
The ''Khetanna'' was a modified luxury sail barge which had three decks with the upper one being covered by two large orange sails. The sails were primarily decorative, but they also protected passengers from the glaring light of Tatooine's twin suns and could propel the vessel at a moderate 30 km/h.<ref name="SWTJ">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal]]''</ref> The usual method of propulsion was a triple-chambered [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine. The upper deck also had a small private lounge, which was used by Jabba's favorite henchmen and guests.

As the vehicle was designed to transport sentient passengers for extended trips, the ''Khetanna''{{'s}} middle deck served as the passenger deck. This deck was highly ornate, decorated with sculptures, tapestries, and other symbols of wealth in order to impress Jabba's guests.<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" /> Despite this, the ''Khetanna'' was actually somewhat under-furnished compared to other sail barges, the main luxury being its extensive galley to cater to Jabba's large appetite.<ref name="CCS" /> A large portion of this deck was occupied by a large banquet room which could double as a throne room for Jabba and his entourage. Jabba used this deck when he ordered [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] thrown into the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], and it was here that he died by strangulation at the hands of his newest slave girl, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]]. The mid-deck also held guest rooms, a lobby, Jabba's private quarters, a fully stocked and expanded kitchen, and the cockpit of the vehicle.<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" /><ref name="SWTJ" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:Sailbarge-chron2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Jabba's Luxury sail barge at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]]]</div>

The barge's lower deck was composed of navigation sensor array, engines, redundant steering systems, a series of prison cells, a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] storage chamber, armory, a repair shop, and several live food tanks containing living animals which the crime lord would feast on at his pleasure.<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" />

When the crime lord acquired the vessel, he installed a custom-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] on the upper deck which could disable most vehicles and had the handrails drilled to hold portable antipersonnel heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. An advanced sensor suite allowed the crime lord to escape detection from his foes.<ref name="SWTJ" /> Also on the barge were several decorations such as masks and [[Ne Ganna Dateel Jabba/Legends|decorative bas-reliefs]].

==History==
[[File:Khetanna_boom.png|thumb|left|250px|The destruction of ''Khetanna'']]

When Jabba the Hutt acquired the ''Khetanna'', he used it for business trips, lavish parties, and tours across the deserts of Tatooine. He often conducted raids on his rivals, often with assistance from a pair of escorting [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiffs]].<ref name="CCS" /> Despite requiring a crew of 26 for proper and safe operation, Jabba was infamous for voyaging with 15 or fewer crewmen, most of whom were kitchen assistants.<ref name="SWTJ" /> Jabba would enter and exit the barge by a large boarding hatch at the observation-deck level on the starboard side of the vessel.<ref name="CCS" /> Due to the reputation of the infamous Jabba, the vessel earned a feared reputation among her master's enemies.

Jabba used the barge to take Luke Skywalker, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to the Great Pit of Carkoon, where they were to be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. The sail barge was destroyed during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fight]] that ensued over the pit after Luke Skywalker retrieved his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. After defeating several of Jabba's guards, Skywalker ordered Leia to point the deck cannon directly at the deck. Just before escaping, Skywalker kicked the firing lever, causing the sail barge to be torn apart by the laser fire.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Although largely stripped of valuables by scavenging [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], the remnants of the ''Khetanna'' near the sarlacc pit were part of Mos Eisley's [[Skywalker Tour]].<ref name="SWTJ" /> Parts of the ''Khetanna'' were eventually used to line the interior of the [[Doe See'ybark Bootana]] restaurant.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Khetanna'' was created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="ROTJ" /> but first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of the film.<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref>
